text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-ALERT-40921 — high 5xx rate on service: inference-gateway-prod (scope: prod-usw2). Trigger: 5xx rate > 8% over 3m. Link: https://pd.example/alerts/PD-40921 :rotating_light:

pagerbot: alert routed to on-call schedule: infra-sre-primary -> jordan. Escalation window: 5m.

jordan: acked. I'm taking this. seeing a 3m spike in 5xx traces on the gateway. grabbing logs.

maya: @jordan thx. customer-facing? Any 503/502s showing in wss or uploads?

jordan: front-line dashboards show error-rate peaking ~12% for inference requests (text-gen path). latency also up ~120ms p50. No broad client disconnects yet but some request retries from a handful of tenants.

sasha: checking metrics: k/v cache miss rate jumped right before spike. looks correlated with canary rollout id=canary-2024-06-18-7

jordan: copying logs: ```[2024-06-18T04:07:12Z] 502 inference-gateway-prod node-13 upstream: timeout while forwarding to backend pool-gpu-3 (conn reset)
[2024-06-18T04:07:13Z] 504 inference-gateway-prod node-08 upstream: kv-cache-miss, fetch-start
[2024-06-18T04:07:14Z] 500 model-serve-42 ERROR: Unhandled exception in handler: "kv cache key nil"```

ops-sre: flipping canary => rollback recommended. canary shows 18% 5xx and higher cpu on model-serve pods.

leo: if we rollback, need quick plan to avoid QoS drop. proposal: scale dedicated pool for prod-usw2 + disable canary traffic. run: `rctl rollout cancel canary-2024-06-18-7` then `infractl autoscale --pool prod-usw2 --delta +4`

jordan: running `rctl rollout cancel` now. pinging deploy bot...

triage-bot: rctl: accepted cancel request for canary-2024-06-18-7, initiating rollback. ETA ~45s for traffic shift.

pagerbot: PD: Alert acknowledged by jordan. Escalation paused. Secondary contact (maya) notified.

maya: Good. I'll open a customer-impact check: @support please watch for high retry tickets. Also posting quick status on status.redwood.ai: "Investigating elevated errors for text-generation endpoint in us-west-2; mitigation in progress."

sasha: quick root-cause note: model-serve introduces a new cache key derivation that returns nil for some input shapes — causes NPE and 500s. disabling that code path in canary should stop the failures.

jordan: rollback completed. traffic shifted to stable. 5xx rate dropped to ~1.1% over last 2m. Confirming logs show less 500s.

ops-sre: monitoring. also noticed PagerDuty didn't auto-escalate to secondary for ~70s due to PD webhook timeouts — filing PD ticket after incident.

leo: can we add a transient route to avoid downstream cold misses? suggestion: warm kv cache by priming top prefixes for heavy tenants — run `kv-warm --prefixes /top-tenants --region usw2`

jordan: warming started. also running a quick golden-traffic eval against stable to ensure no regressions.

maya: customer impact: support reported ~5 tenants with increased retries but no SLA breaches logged yet. outreach on standby for any customers who escalate.

sasha: once warm-up completes, I can re-run canary with the cache-fix toggled off and a stricter traffic split (2%). will also add a unit test for nil-key case.

jordan: notes for postmortem: timeline, canary config delta, PD webhook timeout, suggested runbook updates: - verify cache-key derivation in canaries - add PD webhook retry/backoff visibility - make canary rollback one-click in console

ops-sre: handing off to leo for monitoring and follow-up. jordan — you good to close the PD alert?

jordan: closing PD alert now. PD-ALERT-40921 resolved. I'll stay on monitoring for 30m.

pagerbot: Alert resolved by jordan. Reminder: create postmortem ticket and link PD incident.

leo: taking over follow-up. creating PM ticket: PM-INC-7845 -> include impact, timeline, mitigation, and action items.

maya: thanks everyone. small action items: (1) PD webhook retry ticket (ops-sre) (2) canary preflight checks for cache key (eng-runtime) (3) improve customer alerting for short blips (product/support).

sasha: quick note — I pushed a patch branch `fix/cache-nil-key` and will open a PR with e2e.

jordan: thanks. closing thread unless anyone needs further sync. :white_check_mark:
